title: Adapter pattern: this plan consumes the projection, doesn't extend DontPanic
body: All code in this plan lives outside `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/`. The boundary: DontPanic emits state via projection (plan 2026-05-09-003); this adapter consumes and renders. If a feature requires DontPanic core changes, that signals scope creep and the change should be pulled into the projection plan instead.

title: Single-tenant Firestore shape — multi-tenant archived
body: The dashboard's existing `tenants/{tenantId}/...` shape was for the deprecated multi-tenant Axiom direction. Per plan 2026-05-03-002 D002, that direction is archived. This plan uses single-tenant `projects/{project_id}/...` where project_id is the operator's local DontPanic project_id from `~/.dontpanic/projects.json`. Multi-tenant orchestration becomes a future plan if real demand emerges.

title: Mutations through MCP only, never direct Firestore writes
body: The dashboard's drag-and-drop, approve-button, and dispatch-button UIs MUST call Cloud Functions that call DontPanic MCP. Direct Firestore writes for state changes are rejected by the security rules (F004). This preserves DontPanic's approval semantics: every state-changing tool requires `confirm: true` and surfaces the operation to the user before firing. Bypassing MCP would let the dashboard change state without operator approval — exactly the safety failure DontPanic exists to prevent.

title: Polling daemon v0; long-poll / SSE in v1
body: V0 uses a 5–15s polling daemon because it's simpler, has no port management on the operator's machine, and is robust to restarts. V1 may switch to `state_stream` long-poll once the projection plan ships streaming semantics. Polling latency target ≤30s is acceptable for kanban use; sub-second latency isn't a v0 requirement.

title: Local MCP exposure to Cloud Functions: operator's choice
body: Cloud Functions calling DontPanic MCP need a network path to the operator's local machine. Recommended: Tailscale Funnel (encrypted, identity-aware, no port-forward management). Alternatives: Cloudflare Tunnel, ngrok with auth. Operator picks; F003 documents but doesn't enforce. The daemon-vs-Functions split keeps DontPanic itself unaware of any of this — DontPanic just exposes MCP locally.
